integrity: An explicit infinite 3-adic lifting proof is supplied. Enumeration corroborates but is not used as a universal proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the cubic Dickson polynomial with unit parameter 1, the prime 3, and all powers thereof. The 1991 antecedent was read in a lossy full-text transcription; uncatalogued exact equivalents remain an originality risk. The public image-cardinality result is not claimed as new.
title: The exact ternary fiber law for the cubic Dickson polynomial
